ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
var list = java.getElements(".mh-item"),
  data = [];
list == 0
  ? java.log("🎨阿吧漫画💞：搜索失效，请修复")
  : ""
for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
  data.push({
    name: list[i].select(".title").text(),
    author: "",
    kind: "",
    word: "",
    latest: "",
    intro: "",
    cover: `${String(list[i].select(".mh-cover").attr("style")).replace(/.*\((.*)\),.*/, "$1")},{"headers":{"Referer": "${host}"}}`,
    url: `${list[i].select("a").attr("href")},{"headers":{"Referer": "${host}"}}`
  });
}
JSON.stringify(data);
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
var list = java.getElements(".view-win-list li a"),
  data = [];
list == 0
  ? java.log("🎨阿吧漫画💞：目录失效，请修复")
  : ""
date = String(java.getElements(".tip .block.2").text()).replace(/更新时间：/g, "");
for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
  data.push({
    title: i == list.length - 1 ? `[${list.length}]·${list[i].text()}〔${date}〕` : list[i].text(),
    link: `${list[i].attr("href")},{"headers":{"Referer": "${host}"}}`
  });
};
JSON.stringify(data);
</js>
